headline: Baycurrent Classic Round 3: Mitchell and Bridgeman lead into Moving Day
whyCareReason: Keith Mitchell and Jacob Bridgeman share the 36-hole lead at 11 under, paired with Max Homa (-9) for Saturday's round.
teaser: Leaders tee off at 10:36 AM JST on the par-71 West Course at Yokohama Country Club. 500 FedExCup points at stake.
story: Moving Day is underway at Yokohama Country Club as the PGA Tour's Baycurrent Classic reaches its pivotal third round. Keith Mitchell and Jacob Bridgeman share the 36-hole summit at 11 under par (131) following bogey-free back nines on Friday. Paired with them in the final group is Max Homa, who sits just two strokes off the pace at 9 under alongside Zach Bauchou, Ben Kohles, and Mac Meissner. With no 36-hole cut in this 72-player limited-field tournament, Saturday's third round serves as the launchpad for Sunday's battle over the 8 million dollar purse.
stakes: Moving Day positions players for Sunday's final round and a critical two-year PGA Tour winner exemption.
rivalryAngle: Mitchell and Bridgeman duel in the final group with major winner Max Homa breathing down their necks.
funFacts: Yokohama Country Club's West Course is playing to a par of 71 and 7,322 yards.
Both Mitchell and Bridgeman posted identical totals of 131 through 36 holes.
Japanese crowd favorite Hideki Matsuyama sits four shots back at 7 under.
